administering_body: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments of Rs 2,000 by direct bank transfer
eligibility_rules: Indian citizen in a farmer family that owns cultivable land recorded in state land records; valid Aadhaar and active bank account; e-KYC mandatory. A family means husband, wife and minor children.
exclusions: Institutional landholders; income tax payers; higher-income groups such as serving or retired government officials (with exceptions); professionals such as doctors, engineers and lawyers.
documents_needed: Aadhaar number; bank account details (e-KYC); land ownership records
how_to_apply: Register on pmkisan.gov.in (New Farmer Registration) or visit a Common Service Centre; state nodal officers also assist.
state_variation_note: Land verification and grievance handling happen at state level.

target_group: Economically vulnerable families (deprivation and occupation criteria); seniors 70+ (see note)
benefit: Cashless cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled public and private hospitals
eligibility_rules: Eligibility is based on rural deprivation criteria and urban occupation categories, not an income cap; the person must appear in the PM-JAY beneficiary database. Check with the Am I Eligible feature.
exclusions: People not listed in the beneficiary database (they may still be covered by a state scheme).
documents_needed: Family ID proof such as ration card; identity proof; Aadhaar e-KYC for the Ayushman card
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in or the Ayushman app or at a CSC; complete e-KYC; download or collect the Ayushman card.
state_variation_note: A secondary source says seniors aged 70+ get Rs 5 lakh cover irrespective of income; another secondary source states an income limit for the card. Treat both as unverified and send users to pmjay.gov.in.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS), under NSAP
benefit: Monthly pension. Central assistance reported as Rs 300 per month for ages 40 to 79 and Rs 500 from age 80; states add top-ups.
eligibility_rules: Widow aged 40 or above in a BPL household; should not be getting another social security pension. Pension ends on remarriage.
exclusions: Widows below 40 (centrally); households above the poverty line.
documents_needed: BPL proof or score card; age proof; address proof; citizenship proof; widow status proof
how_to_apply: Apply through the state social welfare department; NSAP online application is available on UMANG in some states.
state_variation_note: Amounts differ by state (for example a state portal lists Rs 1,000 per month in J&K and Rs 300 in Punjab). Older sources quote different age bands.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS), under NSAP
target_group: People aged 60 and above in BPL households
benefit: Monthly pension with a central contribution plus state top-up; amount not confirmed here
eligibility_rules: Applicant aged 60 or more from a BPL household.
documents_needed: BPL proof; age proof; address proof
how_to_apply: Apply through the state social welfare department.
state_variation_note: Amount varies by state; confirm on NSAP before showing any figure.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS), under NSAP
target_group: BPL households on the death of the primary breadwinner
benefit: One-time lump sum; amount not confirmed here
eligibility_rules: Household below the poverty line; death of the primary breadwinner; breadwinner age band 18 to 64 per a state portal.
documents_needed: BPL proof; death certificate; identity and address proof
how_to_apply: Apply through the state social welfare department.
state_variation_note: Age band and amount should be confirmed on NSAP.
